scope: Internal analysis return versus active epoch (I09); not CLI publication or consumption.

stateVariables.epoch,captured,accepted,replaced: Active controller identity and returned analysis identity.

assumptions: One stable observation; replacement is possible only at the configured caller boundary.

safety.AcceptedResultUsesActiveEpoch: Stronger diagnostic property of the return, not a universal product contract.

liveness: None: no caller or external-process completion guarantee.
fairness: None; terminal stuttering represents quiescence only.

bounds.dimensions: One attempt and one replacement, before or inside asynchronous validation.
bounds.pruning: None: no state/action constraints, symmetry or view filtering.

counterexamples: During validation: internal API can return old result. Proposed recheck is model-only.
